title: STILL PRESENT (r2): trio_matches_row compares the submitted NAME against the snapshot while email/phone use the effective contact — the W7 idempotency verdict can 200 a trio that differs from the live successor
detail: The W5 guard compares the effective (corrected) name; the W7 idempotency check compares the raw snapshot name — the diff added corrected_name to GetReferenceCallByIdRow but not to ListReferenceCallsForApplicationRow. A successor corrected between double-submits yields a wrong 200/409 verdict.
recommended_fix: Add corrected_name to ListReferenceCallsForApplicationRow and compare trio.name against effective_value(corrected_name, contact_name), mirroring trio_matches.

title: STILL PRESENT (r2): wrong-person awaiting_correction transition has no SQL taken_over_at guard — a take-over landing between the Gleam read and the UPDATE re-enters a landlord-handled row into the correction loop
evidence:

+        False ->

+  -- r2 (BLOCKER): a taken-over row (A7) is never yanked into the correction
+  -- loop — the landlord is handling it; the §8.6 late completion stays live.
+  AND taken_over_at IS NULL
detail: The r2 fix added the SQL-level taken_over_at guard to the webhook siblings (find_reference_call_by_send_ref, mark_awaiting_correction, exhaust_reference_call) but the wrong-person awaiting_correction leg relies only on the same-request Gleam read; a concurrent take-over can commit in between, and correct_reference_call never clears taken_over_at, leaving a stuck row.
recommended_fix: Guard the wrong-person transition with a taken_over_at IS NULL predicate (dedicated query or parameter), matching mark_awaiting_correction.

title: exhaust_wrong_person swallows a DB error on the guarded exhaustion UPDATE into a silent redirect — no log, no Sentry capture (contrast the stamp-failure path it mirrors)
evidence:
+      case sql.stamp_referee_contact_invalid(config.db, id_uuid) {
+        Ok(_) -> Nil
+        Error(err) ->
+          // r1 (N17): mirror the webhook path — capture to Sentry, never
+          // just a log line (a missing stamp is a silent compliance gap).
+          sentry_client.capture(
...
+      form_pages.view_wrong_person_confirmed()
+      |> ssr_response.to_sensitive_response
+    }
+    _ -> wisp.redirect(to: "/reference/" <> token)
detail: The catch-all `_ ->` folds Error(err) together with the 0-row race: on a DB failure the exhaustion silently never happens, the row stays live with correction_cycles=1 and no diagnostic is written — unlike the stamp failure one arm above, which is captured.
recommended_fix: Split the Error arm in exhaust_wrong_person: log/capture to Sentry before redirecting (or 500), mirroring the module's own N17 convention.
